skim: Warren Buffett, 96, stepped down as Berkshire Hathaway’s chairman after 56 years, handing the role to his son Howard while Greg Abel continues as CEO.
Trump hosts Xi Jinping at the White House Wednesday and Thursday for a summit on trade, Taiwan and AI, with China’s rare-earth export truce expiring November 10.
Zelensky and Trump plan to meet in New York this week as Ukraine fired over 1,000 drones at Russia and Russia’s ruling United Russia party claimed a Duma supermajority in a wartime vote.
DR Congo began vaccinating 50,000 health workers against Ebola as the outbreak’s death toll hit 3,639, while Nigeria suspended 20 officials after 37 detained miners died in custody.
Shafali Verma smashed a 49-ball century to send India into the Asian Games cricket final against Sri Lanka, and Manchester City beat Sunderland 5–3 despite a Brian Brobbey hat-trick.

stories.headline: Putin’s Party Claims Duma Majority In Wartime Vote Marred By Drone Strikes
stories.body: Russia’s ruling United Russia party won 57.19% of the vote in the country’s first State Duma election since the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, with four other Kremlin-approved parties clearing the 5% threshold — the Communists (13.85%), the Liberal Democrats (9.16%), New People (8.01%) and A Just Russia (5.23%) — per Meduza (Sep 21). Polls closed hours after Ukraine launched more than 1,000 drones at Russia overnight, killing two people and wounding 20 near Moscow, while the liberal Yabloko party was barred from the ballot and observers from opposition parties were turned away from polling stations, per ABC News (Sep 20). Exiled Navalny associate Leonid Volkov urged voters to “demand a paper ballot,” as Yulia Navalnaya called for a silent anti-war protest vote.

stories.headline: 37 Miners Die In Nigerian Custody As Officials Are Suspended Amid Outcry
stories.body: Thirty-seven of 67 suspected illegal miners arrested in Niger state died in Nigerian Security and Civil Defense Corps custody, apparently of suffocation, after being detained Tuesday and found dead Thursday, per KSAT/AP (Sep 20). Survivor Mubarak Dahiru said “they beat us as if we were thieves… they also used their guns and hit us,” while victim’s father Lawan Mohammed recalled bringing food to the jail only “to hear that he was dead.” Interior Minister Olubunmi Tunji-Ojo has appointed a 10-member investigation panel and suspended 20 NSCDC personnel, warning that “any attempt to destroy or conceal evidence… will be treated as a serious offense.”

stories.headline: ‘We Are Being Hunted’: South Africa Reels As Nine Women’s Bodies Found
stories.body: Nine women’s bodies have been discovered across Ekurhuleni, greater Johannesburg, between Jul 17 and Sep 17 — the first five in Kempton Park and others 25–35km away in Dawn Park and KwaThema — with only four identified so far: Dineo Motapane, 38; Gracious Nkomo, 28; Elizabeth Moselakgomo, 38; and Itumeleng Kekana, 32, per Al Jazeera (Sep 19). Gauteng police commissioner Fred Kekana said investigators are “considering all possibilities, including multiple suspects or separate perpetrators,” and at least one suspect has appeared in court. Gender Equality Commission’s Princess Eurika Mogane said “this is a war… it feels like individuals are hunted,” citing UN Women data showing South Africa’s femicide rate is five times the global average.

stories.headline: DR Congo Rolls Out Ebola Vaccine For 50,000 Health Workers As Toll Hits 3,639
stories.body: With Ebola deaths in DR Congo now at 3,639 and 7,541 confirmed cases, health authorities have begun a compassionate-use rollout of the Ervebo vaccine to 50,000 health and frontline workers in Bunia (Ituri) and North Kivu, using 70,000 WHO-approved doses, per Al Jazeera (Sep 20). Congolese task force official Steve Ahuka cautioned “we don’t know to what degree it might be effective” against the outbreak’s Bundibugyo strain, since Ervebo was designed for the Zaire strain. Provincial governor Major-General Gaby Kasongo Mulumba said frontline workers are “particularly exposed and deeply involved in the response,” as 20,000 recipients will be monitored for up to a year.

stories.headline: Shafali Verma’s Blistering Ton Sends India Into Asian Games Final
stories.body: Shafali Verma smashed an unbeaten 100 off just 49 balls — three fours, nine sixes — as India thrashed Bangladesh by 114 runs to reach the Asian Games women’s cricket final, per The Tribune and Eastern Herald (Sep 20). It was the first century by a woman in the event’s 28-year history and ties the joint-fastest T20I hundred by a Full Member nation’s player, matching Harmanpreet Kaur’s 2018 mark. India face Sri Lanka for gold on September 22 at Korogi Sports Park in Nisshin, Japan.

stories.headline: Man City Survive Brobbey Hat-Trick To Win Eight-Goal Thriller
stories.body: Manchester City beat Sunderland 5-3 at the Etihad in an eight-goal thriller, with Erling Haaland’s 81st-minute strike standing after a VAR offside check, per beIN Sports and Goal.com (Sep 20). Sunderland’s Brian Brobbey scored all three of his side’s goals but still finished on the losing side: “It’s hard being on the losing side when you’re scoring three goals,” he said. “It’s really hard to lose.” The result kept City top of the Premier League heading into the international break.

stories.headline: Isak Sinks Former Club As Liverpool Win At Bournemouth
stories.body: Alexander Isak scored the only goal as Liverpool won 1-0 at Bournemouth, turning in Cody Gakpo’s cross via a deflection off Florian Wirtz in the 57th minute, per Sky Sports (Sep 20). The win was doubly sweet for Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola, facing his former club: “I’m obviously happy with the result. I know it’s a difficult place to come,” he said. Liverpool moved up to sixth before the international break, while Bournemouth remain winless under Marco Rose.

stories.headline: Verstappen: Hidden Battery Gap Makes Mercedes Threat Hard To Read
stories.body: Max Verstappen said Red Bull’s true power-unit gap to Mercedes is hard to gauge because the FIA’s ADUO review measures only the ICE, not the battery, per GPFans (Sep 19). “You have the measurement of the engine, the ICE, and not the battery, right?” he said, adding: “We just have to do a better job…it takes time.” Since 2026’s power units split evenly between combustion and electrical output, Mercedes could hold a battery edge despite Red Bull’s stronger ICE.

stories.headline: Trump and Xi Meet This Week in High-Stakes Trade Summit
stories.body: President Trump will host Chinese President Xi Jinping at the White House Wednesday and Thursday — Xi’s first Washington visit in a decade — with trade, Taiwan and AI competition topping the agenda, per The National (Sep 21). China’s one-year suspension of rare-earth export controls expires November 10 and a roughly $14 billion US arms package for Taiwan awaits approval, raising the stakes. “This is the summit of the three Ts: Taiwan, technology and trade,” said James Lewis of the Centre for European Policy Analysis.

stories.headline: Dow Notches Third Straight Losing Week As Yields Spike
stories.body: The Dow fell roughly 2% last week — its third consecutive weekly decline — after the Federal Reserve raised rates for the first time in three years and the 10-year Treasury yield climbed back above 5%, a level unseen since 2007, per The Motley Fool (Sep 18). The Nasdaq bucked the trend with a 0.3% weekly gain even as bond markets signalled persistent inflation worries.

stories.headline: Buffett Steps Down As Berkshire Chairman After 56 Years
stories.body: Warren Buffett, 96, has relinquished the Berkshire Hathaway chairmanship he held since 1970, becoming chairman emeritus while his son Howard Buffett takes the gavel, per NPR (Sep 18). CEO Greg Abel, who succeeded Buffett last year, said “Warren’s impact on Berkshire and its owners is without parallel in the history of American business” and that Howard “will be their guardian” of the culture Buffett built.

stories.headline: Bank Of England Holds Rates As UK Inflation Hits 3.1%
stories.body: The Bank of England kept its benchmark rate at 3.75% even as UK inflation climbed to a five-month high of 3.1%, with six of nine Monetary Policy Committee members voting to hold, per Quartz (Sep 17). Policymakers warned inflation could reach 4% early next year and signalled borrowing costs may need to rise again.

stories.headline: US, China Discuss AI ‘Guardrails’ Ahead Of Trump-Xi Summit
stories.body: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng met in New York on Sunday to lay groundwork for this week’s Trump-Xi summit, discussing safeguards to keep powerful AI models “from reaching malign actors,” per Al Jazeera (Sep 20). “The United States remains the leader in AI,” Bessent said, adding Washington is “open to discussions on avoiding shared risks and avoiding bifurcation of our two systems.”

stories.headline: China’s StepFun Launches Step 5, A 600B-Parameter Rival
stories.body: Chinese AI firm StepFun opened API access to Step 5 Preview, a 600-billion-parameter sparse reasoning model with a 1-million-token context window, pricing it at just $1 per million input tokens and $2.70 per million output tokens, per Artificial Analysis (Sep 18). Independent benchmarking placed its intelligence score “well above average” for its price tier, underscoring how quickly Chinese labs are closing the cost gap with US frontier models.

stories.headline: OpenAI’s Hidden Ad Cookie Tracks ChatGPT Users Across Sites
stories.body: A researcher found OpenAI runs a tracking cookie, “__obi,” that links ChatGPT accounts to browsing activity on at least a dozen commercial sites including Chewy, Wayfair and HelloFresh, per a report published Sep 20. The cookie is classified internally as an “analytics” cookie rather than marketing despite feeding ad-targeting pixels, and OpenAI Support acknowledged the inquiry but declined to answer questions about that classification.

stories.headline: Meta’s AI Deepfake Rules Called ‘Fundamentally Inadequate’
stories.body: Meta’s Oversight Board ordered removal of two AI-generated deepfake videos — targeting a Scottish councillor and a Muslim education advocate — and issued 12 recommendations after finding the company’s safeguards “consistently and fundamentally inadequate,” per Tech Central (Sep 18). The board flagged a pattern of women in public life being disproportionately targeted and pushed Meta to add warning screens and reduce algorithmic distribution of flagged AI content.

stories.headline: Zelensky, Trump To Meet In New York As Ukraine Launches Mass Drone Strike
stories.body: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky announced he will meet Donald Trump in New York this week, likely Tuesday during the UN General Assembly, saying “We agreed on a meeting in New York, and this meeting could change a lot” and calling peace “our number one priority,” per UPI (Sep 20). The announcement came as Ukraine fired over 1,000 drones and a new ballistic missile at Russia and seven people died in Russian strikes on the Kyiv and Sumy regions; Secretary of State Marco Rubio called the latest US-Ukraine talks “meaningful,” adding “new ideas were discussed.”

stories.headline: North Korea Fires Suspected Ballistic Missile Into East Sea
stories.body: North Korea launched what Japan’s government called a “suspected ballistic missile” into the East Sea on Sunday, days after Pyongyang rejected a UN nuclear watchdog resolution, per Euronews (Sep 20). Kim Yo Jong warned “our will to defend our sovereignty will be expressed in clearer action,” while Trump — who has said Kim holds “57 very powerful nuclear weapons” — is expected to meet Kim later this year even as South Korea’s President Lee Jae Myung urges Washington to keep dialogue open.

stories.headline: US, China Open High-Level Talks Ahead Of Trump-Xi Summit
stories.body: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng launched talks in New York on trade, AI governance and critical minerals ahead of a Trump-Xi summit at the White House later this week, per Al Jazeera (Sep 20). Bessent said he was “looking forward to having focused, fulsome and constructive talks today that will set the stage for our leaders’ meeting,” with the two sides racing to renew a Busan trade truce — which caps US tariffs on Chinese goods near 20 percent — before it expires November 10.

stories.headline: Poland Scrambles Air Defenses As Russia Pounds Ukraine
stories.body: Poland’s army ran preventive military aviation operations on Saturday, activating ground-based air defenses and radar reconnaissance as Russia launched fresh strikes on Ukraine, per Al Arabiya (Sep 19). The army said “there was no violation of Polish airspace” this time, but the precautionary scramble underscores how Warsaw remains on high alert along NATO’s eastern flank following recent Russian drone and missile incursions.

stories.headline: Sheinbaum Says Mexico-US Trade Deal Advancing After Trump Call
stories.body: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said she held a “very good” call with Donald Trump as the two governments race to strike a bilateral trade deal before US midterm elections, per Al Jazeera (Sep 18). “Progress is being made toward a potential agreement between us, Mexico, and the United States,” she said, with Mexico pushing for reduced US tariffs on steel, aluminum and automobiles within the USMCA framework.

fixtures.headline: Asian Games Gold Medal Final: India v Sri Lanka
fixtures.body: India, fresh off Shafali Verma’s record century, face Sri Lanka for the women’s cricket gold medal on September 22 at Korogi Sports Park in Nisshin, Japan. Sri Lanka reached the final by beating Pakistan by eight wickets in the other semi-final.

fixtures.headline: Azerbaijan Grand Prix Moves To A Saturday
fixtures.body: F1 heads to Baku for the Azerbaijan Grand Prix on September 24-26, with the race itself shifted to Saturday for the first time to avoid a clash with the country’s Remembrance Day on September 27. It is only the second Saturday race on the calendar after Las Vegas.

fixtures.headline: West Indies Open India Tour With First ODI
fixtures.body: West Indies begin their tour of India with the first of three ODIs in Thiruvananthapuram on September 27, kicking off a white-ball series ahead of the Test leg.

portfolio.headline: Meta gets JPMorgan upgrade and $820 target after Muse AI agent launch, with Connect event days away
portfolio.body: JPMorgan upgraded Meta to Overweight and lifted its price target to $820 from $640 following the launch of Meta's Muse personal AI agent, while Citi held its Buy rating and $800 target on a 90-day catalyst watch tied to the Meta Connect event starting September 23. Both firms point to Meta's AI initiatives — including agentic ad tools and a nascent ‘neocloud’ compute business — as the next leg of earnings growth, coming off Q2 revenue of $60.8 billion and a 31% operating margin, per Ad-Hoc News (Sep 20).

portfolio.headline: Oracle's slide traced to macro, not a company-specific blow-up, as its debt load amplifies rate jitters
portfolio.body: Oracle's pullback this month has been driven by macro forces rather than any operational setback: Middle East tensions pushed oil and Treasury yields higher, and markets began pricing in a greater chance of another Fed rate hike, pressuring richly-valued growth names. Oracle's roughly $96 billion in long-term debt (debt-to-equity above 4x) makes it especially sensitive to rising rates, even as the company continues to post quarterly revenue near $14.9 billion with an EBIT margin near 36%, per Timothy Sykes News (Sep 14).

portfolio.headline: CrowdStrike gets a BofA price-target bump to $260 as Wall Street splits over its valuation
portfolio.body: Bank of America raised its CrowdStrike price target to $260 from $230 on September 20 while keeping a Neutral rating, even as valuation models flagged the shares as trading well above intrinsic-value estimates. The moves follow CrowdStrike's fiscal Q2 report of record revenue of $1.47 billion (up 26% year-over-year) and record net-new annual recurring revenue of $333 million (up 51%), with total ARR reaching $5.84 billion, per Ad-Hoc News (Sep 20).

portfolio.headline: Arm price targets split as Wells Fargo cuts to $350 while Jefferies and Susquehanna lift theirs to $320
portfolio.body: Analysts diverged on Arm Holdings this week: Wells Fargo trimmed its target to $350 from $410 (Overweight), while Jefferies raised its target to $320 from $290 (Buy) and Susquehanna lifted its to $320 from $300 (Positive), reflecting mixed views on how much of Arm's AI-royalty growth is already priced in. The adjustments come ahead of fiscal Q1 results, with consensus looking for revenue of about $1.26 billion versus $1.05 billion a year earlier, per Ad-Hoc News (Sep 20).

portfolio.headline: Cloudflare's pullback tracks the broader software de-rating, with no fresh company-specific news
portfolio.body: No new company-specific announcement was found behind Cloudflare's move this session; it appears tied to the same valuation reset hitting Oracle, CrowdStrike and other high-multiple software names. Zacks (Hold rating) has flagged Cloudflare's forward P/E near 226x against consensus estimates of $0.34 EPS (up about 26% year-over-year) and revenue near $732.9 million (up about 30% year-over-year) for the coming quarter, per Yahoo Finance (Sep 4).

portfolio.headline: Rackspace faces securities suit after its AI push forced a $150M guidance cut
portfolio.body: Rackspace Technology faces an investor class action alleging it misrepresented how its AI infrastructure buildout would strain resources: the company cut full-year revenue guidance by $150 million and trimmed its Private Cloud outlook by $25 million after previously saying its AMD partnership gave it confidence in the growth profile. The claims center on disclosures made around July 9, and the lead-plaintiff deadline in the case is September 28, per GlobeNewswire (Sep 16).

portfolio.headline: C3.ai guides to just $240M in fiscal 2027 revenue as founder's exit compounds a steep sales slide
portfolio.body: C3.ai's revenue fell to $250.3 million in fiscal 2026 (down 35% year-over-year) and slid further to $52.4 million in the following fiscal Q1 (down 25% year-over-year), a decline the company links partly to the September 2025 departure of founder Thomas Siebel, who had been central to sales relationships. Net losses hit $470.3 million for fiscal 2026 before narrowing to a $92.8 million loss in the most recent quarter, and management now guides to only about $240 million in revenue for fiscal 2027, per Yahoo Finance/The Motley Fool (Sep 9).

portfolio.headline: Figma slides as post-IPO lock-up unlocks stock, compounded by a swing to GAAP losses and exec departures
portfolio.body: A major post-IPO lock-up expiration has flooded the market with newly tradeable Figma shares, adding selling pressure on top of company-specific concerns: a shift to a GAAP operating loss, a 101% jump in R&D spending tied to AI investment, the departure of two senior executives, and a cautious Q3 revenue outlook. No analyst price-target changes have been issued around the event, per TipRanks (Aug 12, updated Sep 18).

stories.headline: Election Commission Clarifies SIR Notices Sent To Kejriwal, Jaishankar
stories.body: The Election Commission said notices sent to over 3.31 million Delhi voters during the Special Intensive Revision, including to ex-CM Arvind Kejriwal, EAM S. Jaishankar and BJP veteran L.K. Advani, do not automatically mean deletion from the rolls. The CEO office said “no name can be deleted without giving an opportunity of being heard and a proper speaking and appealable order,” per WION (Sep 21); cases must be resolved by October 29 ahead of the final roll on November 4.

stories.headline: Noel Tata Challenges Chandrasekaran’s Reappointment As Tata Sons Chief
stories.body: Tata Trusts chairman Noel Tata has contested N. Chandrasekaran’s reappointment as Tata Sons chairman after the board decision passed on a single casting vote from director Harish Manwani, with Noel Tata and Venu Srinivasan opposed. Noel wrote that presenting the decision as final “when directors were assured the matter remained conditional…is irresponsible,” while Tata Trusts countered that “a casting vote cannot revive a stillborn resolution,” per WION (Sep 21).

stories.headline: Trump’s Russia Sanctions Bill Puts India’s Oil Imports In A Bind
stories.body: US President Trump has signed the Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026, authorising tariffs of up to 100% on countries still buying Russian oil and gas — a direct hit to India, the world’s third-largest oil importer, which per CREA estimates has accounted for 37% of Russia’s crude exports since December 2022. India has maintained it will keep buying from “diversified sources to ensure energy security for its 1.4 billion people,” per WION (Sep 20), leaving New Delhi to weigh higher domestic fuel prices against US tariff exposure.

stories.headline: Burnham Heads To Meet Trump As Aides Blame Him For Economic Woes
stories.body: PM Andy Burnham will hold his first in-person meeting with President Trump at the UN General Assembly in New York, with senior Labour officials pinning much of Britain’s economic strain on US tariff policy. UK inflation rose to 3.1% in August from 2.9% in July, and Burnham said “with inflation where it is, it is a concern…we will look carefully at all of those things,” ahead of Chancellor John Healey’s October 28 budget, per a Bloomberg-sourced report (Sep 20).

stories.headline: UK Jails Teen Asylum Seeker Who Steered Overcrowded Channel Boat
stories.body: A Canterbury Crown Court judge sentenced Chan Mathok Atak, a 19-year-old South Sudanese asylum seeker, to two years and three months for piloting a 14-metre dinghy carrying 165 people, including 31 children, across the Channel in July — at the time the largest crossing on a single small boat. Judge Sarah Counsell said “only an immediate custodial sentence can be justified,” per Al Jazeera (Sep 19), in the first conviction under a new January 2026 law targeting boat pilots.

stories.headline: Qatar PM Calls Iran War Fallout An ‘Earthquake’ At UN
stories.body: Addressing the UN General Assembly, Qatar’s Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani described the economic fallout of the US-Israel war on Iran as “an earthquake” sending “shock waves” through energy supplies and shipping routes well beyond the Middle East. He warned that “permanent security cannot be built through arrangements that leave any state permanently exposed to insecurity,” per Al Jazeera (Sep 20), as Qatar’s foreign ministry confirmed it continues mediating to revive Iran-US talks.

stories.headline: Qatar Condemns Storming Of Al-Aqsa Mosque By Israeli Minister, Settlers
stories.body: Qatar’s Foreign Ministry condemned the entry of Israel’s National Security Minister and settlers into Al-Aqsa Mosque under police protection, calling it “a flagrant violation of international law and international humanitarian law” and stressing the mosque “is exclusively a place of worship for Muslims,” per The Peninsula Qatar (Sep 20). Doha urged the international community to pressure Israel to halt such “provocations,” reaffirming support for a Palestinian state on 1967 borders with East Jerusalem as its capital.

stories.headline: Qatar Launches ‘Doha Investment’ To Drive Non-Oil Growth
stories.body: Qatar unveiled Doha Investment, a new platform managing QIA’s domestic portfolio — including Qatar Airways, QNB and Ooredoo — spanning over 40 companies in more than 80 markets, with over 20 of them posting revenues above QAR 1 billion in 2025. PM Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman said “we aim to expand the private sector’s role in driving Qatar’s economic growth,” per The Peninsula Qatar (Sep 20), with the platform also set to back a new national AI platform, Qai.

doha_events.headline: Google Cloud Summit Doha Lands at QNCC, Sept 22
doha_events.body: Google Cloud brings its annual summit to the Qatar National Convention Centre (Halls 8 & 9) on September 22, with sessions on AI and cloud infrastructure running from 8:30 AM. Entry is free with registration, per Qatar Living (Sep 20).

doha_events.headline: International Ice Cream Show Scoops Into Mall of Qatar, Sept 24–Oct 3
doha_events.body: A free family-friendly ice cream showcase runs at the Oasis Stage in Mall of Qatar from September 24 through October 3, with performances and tastings at 4:30 PM, 6:00 PM and 7:30 PM daily. Details via Qatar Living (Sep 20).

doha_events.headline: Sid Sriram Live in Doha Hits QNCC, Sept 25
doha_events.body: Indian playback singer Sid Sriram performs live at the Qatar National Convention Centre’s Hall 7 on September 25 at 8:00 PM. Tickets start at QAR 220 via Platinumlist, per Qatar Living (Sep 20).

doha_events.headline: QPO Performs Tchaikovsky’s Romeo & Juliet at Katara, Sept 26
doha_events.body: The Qatar Philharmonic Orchestra presents Tchaikovsky’s Romeo & Juliet at the Katara Opera House on September 26 from 7:30–9:30 PM. Tickets start at QAR 175 via Platinumlist, per Qatar Living (Sep 20).

doha_events.headline: Mena W Fena Showcases Local Businesses at Al Hazm, Sept 24–Oct 24
doha_events.body: A month-long market and cultural showcase spotlighting Qatari and local businesses runs at Al Hazm from September 24 through October 24, free to attend. Per Qatar Living (Sep 20), it’s part of a busy late-September lineup across Doha.
